topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I just can't believe this. I was looking forward to that surprise party for weeks. Everyone promised they'd make it special, and now it's all been called off. Just like that, without a second thought. They must think I’m some kind of fool who can just brush this off. It’s not like I can just undo all the anticipation, the excitement that's been building up. I had hoped for a night where I could finally relax, surrounded by the people who supposedly care about me. Instead, I get a lame excuse over a text. Great, just great.
